planningDate.description: Planning run the order belongs to; later than orderDate after a published deferral

sourceDaysSinceServed.description: Days since last served, supplied with imported scenario data

sourceDeferredYesterday.description: Deferred-yesterday flag supplied with imported scenario data

currentOrderStatus.description: Current order status; filled by the service, not stored

repeatSkips.description: Deferrals that extend a consecutive skip

carried.description: The count was carried over from the replaced manifest

loadedUnits.description: Units actually loaded; null while pending

holdsVehicle.description: True holds the vehicle until the dispatcher decides

lines.description: In loading order: the last stop is loaded first

loadedAt.description: When the trip was marked loaded and handed to the driver

replacesTaskId.description: Task of the replaced version for the same vehicle and trip

planVersion.description: Version of the current published plan; null when nothing is published

change.description: ADDED, REMOVED (take off the vehicle if loaded) or RESEQUENCED

loadedUnits.description: Units already on the vehicle from the replaced manifest

status.description: pending, partial or loaded (every order counted)

currentTaskId.description: When this manifest was superseded: the task that replaced it

handoverBlockers.description: Why the trip cannot be marked loaded yet; empty when it can

basedOnPlanId.description: The published plan this candidate revises; null for the first version of a run

ruleVersion.description: Rule set the published schedule was validated with

supersededByPlanId.description: Set when a later version replaced this published plan

startFrom.description: Only when the run already has a published version: 'published' (default) starts the revision from a copy of its trips, 'empty' starts with every order unassigned

reasonCode.description: Required when deferring; ignored on restore

position.description: 1-based stop position kept exactly as given; when omitted the order takes its EDD slot and the other stops keep their order

orderIds.description: On trip creation the stops are placed in the default EDD order (effective window close, then order ID); set an explicit order with the sequence endpoint

fairness.description: Repeat-skip evidence for every order in the run, keyed by order ID

published.description: Published and superseded plans: the schedule, driver and load task frozen at publication. Empty for candidates

carriedForward.description: Carried into this run by an earlier published deferral

daysSinceLastServed.description: From imported scenario data; null when not supplied

deferredPreviousOperatingDay.description: Outlet was deferred on the previous operating day (history or source data)

evidenceSource.description: history, source, history+source or none: where the repeat-skip evidence came from

priorConsecutiveDeferrals.description: Consecutive operating days the outlet was skipped up to the previous run

driverUserId.description: Null when no active driver account is linked to the vehicle

held.description: A shortfall holds this vehicle at the dock
